text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I offer my sincere congratulations
as we welcome the new year in good health and fortune.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "We are finally entering the Classic Year, marking the start of our most crucial year."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes. The Triple Tiara, comprised of the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Especially the Oka Sho, which Mother won, and the Yushun Himba, where she was defeated... I will make sure to deliver results in these two races.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I will deliver a result that satisfies
even those who have waited so long."

What Daiichi Ruby has in mind
is likely a certain column published the other day.
The reporter, who claimed to be a huge fan of the "Splendid Clan," brought up a certain Umamusume and shared their genuine concerns as a fan.
—Mejiro Ramonu. The great Umamusume who achieved the Triple Tiara for the first time in history.
"Right after her debut, she boldly contested race after race and claimed the Triple Tiara. Even if she might not possess other-dimensional strength—"
"Many Umamusume competing on the Tiara route tend to be early bloomers. Hence, the hope was for her to enter races early on—"
"Daiichi Ruby must avenge her mother's loss and claim the Triple Tiara at all costs." That was the main thrust of the column.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I can now state with certainty that all
concerns regarding her legs have been completely dispelled.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First up is the prep race, the Fillies' Revue.
I will show my true abilities there
and prove there is nothing to worry about.

She had already said everything I was going to say,
but it confirmed that we shared the same goal—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to your continued guidance and support
this year as well."
choice_data_list: Likewise, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: Ruby, do you have more greetings to make after this?

text_block_list.text:
As a scion of a clan with extensive connections in business and politics,
it was easy to imagine how busy she would be making New Year's greetings.
Or so I thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No.
I have already finished greeting everyone in the clan.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Anyone other than them will be asked
to visit only if necessary.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall practice on my own.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Now that introductions are out of the way,
I shall take my leave."
Since it's New Year's, I want her to get plenty of rest too. With that in mind—
choice_data_list: Let's do the New Year's calligraphy real quick.
Have you eaten New Year's osechi yet?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Kakizome...
choice_data_list: I've even prepared a New Year's calligraphy set!

text_block_list.text:
Heading into this crucial year, to reaffirm my resolve to work hard,
I had prepared one for myself in advance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...Is that set the box we can see over there?"
choice_data_list: It's the one I used in class back in elementary school...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please wait for 30 minutes.

30 minutes later—what Daiichi Ruby's butler brought over
were expensive-looking paper, brushes inside paulownia wood boxes...
and many other tools.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Though they are broadly referred to as calligraphy tools, there are many subtle differences depending on their intended use.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For instance, calligraphy paper differs depending on
whether it is meant for kana or kanji.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I had the butler prepare a variety of options this time.
I told him to explain them, so please choose the tools you prefer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what she plans to write,
but she's likely declaring her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"You seem to be someone who places great value on emotions.
If the first calligraphy of the new year gives you strength, it benefits me as well."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I took the liberty of preparing the environment for you.
However, it is unnecessary for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to express it on paper.
My resolve—is already etched into my being.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At home, we enjoyed traditional Japanese celebratory meals
prepared by our chef.

Come to think of it, it's hard to picture Daiichi Ruby
gathering around a tiered bento box with her family, picking at the food.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure I grasped the intent of your question,
but did that adequately answer it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I need to go change now,
so if you'll excuse me.
In the end, I couldn't stop Daiichi Ruby. If that was the case, I at least wanted to bring her something to snack on during her self-training, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —And so, you're giving this to me.
choice_data_list: I tried to make it osechi-style, at least...

text_block_list.text: After that, I went to the supermarket and, following what I'd seen others do, lightly packed up some New Year's foods like datemaki, salmon roe, red-and-white kamaboko, and black soybeans.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: ...Each ingredient in osechi has a different meaning!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am aware.
...
choice_data_list: I hoped it might bring you a little comfort...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment.
However, such concern is—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

For some reason, words I didn't even mean slipped out...!
As I flusteredly tried to smooth things over—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totallyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
My message went straight to their brain☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios,
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And now, love you~☆
choice_data_list: Wait, what do you mean it "reached your brain"...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna party with Ruby!
But she'd just give me the cold shoulder, right??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so like, I was thinking of asking you!
And then I sent out all those telepathic vibes and they reached you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand!! Milady!!
Shall we let's-party-here-we-go this thing!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry, but I have business to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Saaaaalt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Pien?
"It felt like, somehow, a sense of camaraderie had sprouted between me and Daitaku Helios... It was that kind of New Year's."
